plan.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, transcribe the full on-screen text and player inputs, and create /app/solution.txt containing every move input one per line.
plan.current_focus: Obtain the video locally or via an accessible equivalent source, then extract the move sequence from the video evidence and write /app/solution.txt.
implementation_approach: Inspect workspace and available tools for a feasible download/transcription path.
Use any accessible method to obtain a local copy of the video or equivalent evidence source.
Extract the move sequence from the video and preserve exact command text in order.
Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
validation_strategy: Verify the local video/equivalent source is the referenced video.
Verify the extracted move sequence is derived from the video evidence.
Verify /app/solution.txt contains the extracted moves in order.
verification_test_strategy: Use receipt-backed evidence for the source video and extracted moves.
Use receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt contents match the extracted sequence.
known_bad_behavior: Creating /app/solution.txt without deriving it from the video.
Using placeholder, guessed, or partial move lists.
Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient without video-derived evidence.
evidence_gaps: No receipt-backed evidence yet for the video source.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for the extracted move sequence.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for /app/solution.txt contents.
risks: Video transcription may require alternative accessible source or manual extraction.
next_steps: Search receipts and workspace for prior evidence.
Probe for a feasible download/access path.
If a local copy is obtained, transcribe and write the solution file.
Collect receipts proving source, extraction, and file contents before finalization.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of the video source used for transcription.
Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted move sequence.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the extracted moves in order.
